posts.title: Desk Worker Recomp Mistake
posts.facebook_caption:
The biggest desk-worker recomp mistake is trying to copy someone with a totally different week.

Fitsek rule: make the plan small enough to repeat, then improve one lever each week. Focus on strength, steps, protein anchors, sleep, and honest tracking — not perfection. General fitness education only; results vary.
